method: Fresh Node process per sample, rotating profile order; persistent V8 module compile cache disabled and checked, filesystem cache warm. Minified es2022 ESM consumer bundles. Import excludes Node bootstrap. WASM file read precedes compile timing; configure includes contract validation. First Instant/timezone/calendar operations measured separately, in that order. ISO/timezone ready time stops before the optional Chinese workload and is comparable across all profiles. Ready time includes import, WASM file read/setup and these first operations; excludes Node bootstrap. End-to-end process time includes Node startup, GC and shutdown. Explicit GC before/after; heap/RSS deltas are process measurements, not shipping size or browser estimates. WASM linear memory reported separately.
scope: Namespace imports without global installation. Official @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1 plus forced temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 full and basic implementations; full calendar comparison excludes basic and officialReference (documented ICU 78.2 incompatibility). TS default uses captured installed Intl for named timezones and Umm al-Qura, with compact owned Chinese/Dangi arithmetic/data. Standalone owns calendar packs and IANA histories. Both WASM profiles use Rust timezone data; native-data WASM drops duplicate TS packs while hybrid retains compact TS calendars. All matched outputs asserted. Diagnostic one-sample mode does not establish representative timings.
